say:3:1122212001:1.text: Need something? Or are you just looking to buy a drink for a pretty girl like me?
say:3:1122212001:1.source_cn: 有什么事吗？如果你是来请我一杯的，我没意见。
say:3:1122212001:1.male: Need something? Or are you just looking to buy a drink for a pretty girl like me?
say:3:1122212001:1.female: Need something? Or are you just looking to buy a drink for a pretty girl like me?

choice_prompt:4:1122212001.text: Need something? Or are you just looking to buy a drink for a pretty girl like me?
choice_prompt:4:1122212001.source_cn: 有什么事吗？如果你是来请我一杯的，我没意见。
choice_prompt:4:1122212001.male: Need something? Or are you just looking to buy a drink for a pretty girl like me?
choice_prompt:4:1122212001.female: Need something? Or are you just looking to buy a drink for a pretty girl like me?

say:5:1122212002:1.text: Darn, am I famous now because of that? Ah, how embarrassing...
say:5:1122212002:1.source_cn: ……我已经因为这事出名了吗？\n唉，还真是丢人啊……

say:6:1122212003:1.text: They cleaned me out. I can't offer a bounty to get my stuff back even if I wanted to. Sorry if you were here for that.
say:6:1122212003:1.source_cn: 我身上的金币都被骗光了，没钱悬赏，你请回吧。
say:6:1122212003:1.male: They cleaned me out. I can't offer a bounty to get my stuff back even if I wanted to. Sorry if you were here for that.
say:6:1122212003:1.female: They cleaned me out. I can't offer a bounty to get my stuff back even if I wanted to. Sorry if you were here for that.

say:7:1122212004:1.text: W-wait, we're here to help! And we don't expect compensation!
say:7:1122212004:1.source_cn: 等等，我们不是来帮你——不对，我们不是来接委托的！

say:8:1122212005:1.text: Those bandits who cheated you are probably the same ones who robbed the Buckthorn Caravan, and we're here to get your story.
say:8:1122212005:1.source_cn: 骗你钱的那群盗匪，应该就是劫走红沙棘商队货物的人！我们...

say:9:1122212008:1.text: What?! I can't believe they even robbed a caravan. That's outrageous!
say:9:1122212008:1.source_cn: 什么？！这群混蛋都敢直接抢劫？！简直无法无天了！

say:10:1122212009:1.text: Alright, what do you want to know? I'll tell you everything.
say:10:1122212009:1.source_cn: 说吧，你们有什么想了解的，我一定知无不言。

choice_prompt:11:1122212009.text: Alright, what do you want to know? I'll tell you everything.
choice_prompt:11:1122212009.source_cn: 说吧，你们有什么想了解的，我一定知无不言。

say:12:1122212010:1.text: I sold them some goods, and they didn't pay up. They reneged on our deal!
say:12:1122212010:1.source_cn: 很简单。先交货，再拿钱——我遵守了规矩，他们却赖账了。

say:13:1122212011:1.text: What did you sell to them?

say:14:1122212012:1.text: Some simple weapons, like daggers, arrows, smoke bombs.
say:14:1122212012:1.source_cn: 一些可以随身携带的武器，匕首、袖箭、烟雾弹之类的。

say:15:1122212013:1.text: Hm? Those weapons are more for self-defense. Do bandits really need those?
say:15:1122212013:1.source_cn: 哎？这些东西更像是防身用的，盗匪真的用得到吗？

say:16:1122212014:1.text: No idea, but the guy I traded with didn't seem like a bandit. If his underlings hadn't said what they said, I wouldn't have even guessed they were bad guys.
say:16:1122212014:1.source_cn: 这我就不知道了，不过他们派来和我交易的那家伙的确不怎么...

choice_prompt:17:1122212014.text: No idea, but the guy I traded with didn't seem like a bandit. If his underlings hadn't said what they said, I wouldn't have even guessed they were bad guys.
choice_prompt:17:1122212014.source_cn: 这我就不知道了，不过他们派来和我交易的那家伙的确不怎么像盗匪。要不是他手下说漏了嘴，我也不知道他们的身份。

say:18:1122212015:1.text: I remember them blaming the Quicksand Claws for some theft and saying something about "the most dangerous place is also the safest."
say:18:1122212015:1.source_cn: 我记得说的是“把抢东西的事推给流沙之爪”，还有什么……...

say:19:1122212016:1.text: Though I'm not sure what that last part means. Perhaps they were talking about their camp's location?
say:19:1122212016:1.source_cn: 不过，后面这一句具体指的是什么，我就不清楚了。可能是他...

say:20:1122212017:1.text: "The most dangerous place"... Maybe they mean the Quicksand Claw camp?
say:20:1122212017:1.source_cn: 最危险的地方……难道是指流沙之爪的营地？

say:21:1122212018:1.text: Come to think of it, the <style="highlight">Quicksand Claw camp</style> is to the southeast of Alkali. It matches Cyril's intel! Could the bandits be hiding nearby?

say:22:1122212019:1.text: Either way, thanks for the info, miss!
say:22:1122212019:1.source_cn: 不管怎么样，谢谢你提供的情报，被骗的商人小姐！

choice:4:0:1.source_cn: 你就是那个被盗匪骗了的商人吧

say:24:1122212006:1.text: Huh... but I really can't repay you. Are you sure you're okay with that?
say:24:1122212006:1.source_cn: 呃……你说的是骗我货物的那群盗匪？但我没发悬赏啊。

say:25:1122212007:1.text: Don't worry! They also swindled the Buckthorn Caravan, so we'll be paid by that bounty!
say:25:1122212007:1.source_cn: 他们劫走了红沙棘商队的货物，商队正在悬赏他们呢！

choice:4:1:2.text: I'd like to hear what happened.
choice:4:1:2.source_cn: 我想打听一下那群盗匪的事
choice:4:1:2.male: I'd like to hear what happened.
choice:4:1:2.female: I'd like to hear what happened.
